configurations.name: static-server-ps
runtimeArgs: $Root='D:\GitHub\Camply-Portal'; $listener=New-Object System.Net.HttpListener; $listener.Prefixes.Add("http://127.0.0.1:$($env:PORT)/"); $listener.Start(); $mime=@{'.html'='text/html';'.js'='application/javascript';'.css'='text/css';'.json'='application/json';'.svg'='image/svg+xml';'.png'='image/png';'.ico'='image/x-icon';'.webmanifest'='application/manifest+json';'.jpg'='image/jpeg';'.jpeg'='image/jpeg';'.gif'='image/gif'}; while($listener.IsListening){$ctx=$listener.GetContext();$req=$ctx.Request;$path=$req.Url.LocalPath;if($path -eq '/'){$path='/index.html'};$file=Join-Path $Root ($path.TrimStart('/') -replace '/','\'); $res=$ctx.Response; try{ if(Test-Path $file -PathType Leaf){ $bytes=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file); $ext=[System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($file).ToLower(); $ct=$mime[$ext]; if(-not $ct){$ct='application/octet-stream'}; $res.ContentType=$ct; $res.ContentLength64=$bytes.Length; $res.OutputStream.Write($bytes,0,$bytes.Length) } else { $res.StatusCode=404 } } catch { $res.StatusCode=500 } finally { $res.OutputStream.Close() } }
